name: 金融（按揭/评估/担保）服务

map.综合计算房产按揭贷款，输入房产评估价值、贷款成数、贷款利率和年限，计算可贷额度、: A full mortgage calculator: enter the appraised value, loan-to-value ratio, interest rate and term to obtain the loanable amount, monthly payment, total interest and an estimate of guarantee fees.
map.📖 查看「金融（按揭/评估/担保）服务 使用指南」: 📖 View the "Mortgage, Valuation and Guarantee Services User Guide"
map.贷款成数通常首套70%，二套50%-60%，具体以银行政策为准: LTV is usually 70% for a first home and 50%-60% for a second; the bank's policy governs
map.利率以银行最新LPR报价为准，公积金贷款利率更低: Rates follow the bank's latest LPR quote; provident fund loans are cheaper
map.等额本金总利息更少，但前期还款压力大: Equal-principal repayment costs less total interest but front-loads the burden
map.担保费按贷款金额的一定比例收取，一般0.3%-1%: Guarantee fees are charged as a share of the loan, usually 0.3%-1%
map.申请经营贷或消费贷前，按评估值测算可贷额度与月供。: Before applying for a business or consumer loan, estimate the loanable amount and monthly payment from the appraised value.
map.对比等额本息与等额本金两种还款方式的总利息。: Compare total interest between equal-installment and equal-principal repayment.
map.转贷时判断新方案月供是否低于当前还款压力。: When refinancing, check whether the new plan lowers the monthly payment against the current burden.
map.房产评估值 500 万、贷款成数 70% → 可贷 350 万；年利率 4.2%: Appraised value 5 million yuan at 70% LTV gives a 3.5 million yuan loan; at 4.2% a year over 30 years the equal-installment payment is about 17,120 yuan a month and total interest about 2.66 million yuan.
map.同样 350 万、4.2%、30 年，等额本金首月≈6,278 元、末月≈2,7: On the same 3.5 million yuan at 4.2% over 30 years, equal-principal starts at about 6,278 yuan and ends at about 2,779 yuan, with total interest of about 632,000 yuan, saving roughly 2 million yuan of interest but with a heavier early burden.
map.评估值和市场价为何不同？: Why do appraised value and market price differ?
map.银行评估值通常保守于成交价（取近期可比案例下探），可贷额度按评估值而非合同价，故: Bank appraisals are usually conservative against the transaction price (taking the low end of recent comparables), and the loanable amount follows the appraised value rather than the contract price, so net proceeds may fall short of expectations.
map.担保费怎么算？: How is the guarantee fee calculated?
map.经营贷担保费一般按贷款额的 1%–3% 一次性收取，示例中 350 万×担保费率: Guarantee fees on business loans are usually charged once at 1%-3% of the loan; in this example 3.5 million yuan × the fee rate gives the fee.
map.房产按揭金融服务计算器，输入房产评估价值和贷款参数，计算可贷额度、月供、总利息和: A property mortgage calculator: enter the appraised value and loan parameters to get the loanable amount, monthly payment, total interest and guarantee fee, with both equal-installment and equal-principal repayment.
